description.text: Welcome to Imperial Enterprise Lab, a dedicated support service for entrepreneurial students, staff and alumni.

targetApplicants.text: Imperial Enterprise Lab supports all founders free of charge, often at the earliest stages of development – before anyone else will back them and without any expectation of recompense.
